memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: fatigue and tingling in feet.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: The patient reports progressive fatigue over the past two months and numbness in both feet, worse in the mornings. He denies chest pain, dyspnoea or fever.
EXAMINATION: BP 138/86 mmHg, pulse 78/min, regular. Weight 78 kg, height 1.70 m, BMI 27.0 (obese). Cardiovascular and respiratory exams normal. Neurological exam shows decreased vibratory sense at ankles and mild distal weakness in lower limbs.
IMPRESSION: Vitamin B12 deficiency likely contributing to anaemia and neuropathy. No evidence of thyroid dysfunction or folate deficiency.
ARRANGEMENTS: Order serum vitamin B12, MCV, haemoglobin, fasting lipid profile and fasting blood sugar. Start methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD. Advise weight reduction to <23 BMI through reduced carbohydrate intake and daily 30‑minute walk. Offer influenza vaccine; patient to receive today. Return if worsening numbness, difficulty walking, confusion, chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C or blood in stools.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum vitamin B12: 150 pg/mL (ref 200‑900). MCV: 102 fL (ref 80‑100). Haemoglobin: 11.2 g/dL (ref 13.0‑17.0). Fasting lipid profile: total cholesterol 210 mg/dL (<200), HDL 38 mg/dL (>40), LDL 130 mg/dL (<100), triglycerides 180 mg/dL (<150). Fasting blood sugar: 102 mg/dL (70‑100).

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Methylcobalamin 1500 mcg oral once daily. Duration: 3 months, then review.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: follow‑up of B12 replacement.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports improved energy; tingling in feet less intense, now only occasional. No new symptoms.
EXAMINATION: BP 136/84 mmHg, weight 76 kg, BMI 25.3 (obese). Cardiovascular and respiratory exams normal. Neurological exam: vibratory sense improved at ankles, mild distal weakness unchanged.
IMPRESSION: Partial response to methylcobalamin; anaemia improving but neuropathy slow. Continue current dose.
ARRANGEMENTS: Repeat serum B12, MCV, Hb, fasting lipids and FBS. Reinforce diet and activity advice to achieve BMI <23. Influenza vaccine already given; note date 05‑Apr‑2025. Return if worsening numbness, gait difficulty, confusion, chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C or blood in stools.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum vitamin B12: 340 pg/mL (ref 200‑900). MCV: 96 fL (ref 80‑100). Haemoglobin: 12.8 g/dL (ref 13.0‑17.0). Fasting lipid profile: total cholesterol 195 mg/dL, HDL 40 mg/dL, LDL 115 mg/dL, triglycerides 150 mg/dL. Fasting blood sugar: 98 mg/dL.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Methylcobalamin 1500 mcg oral once daily. Continue for another 3 months.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: routine review and influenza vaccination.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient feels well; residual mild tingling in toes only on prolonged standing. No fatigue.
EXAMINATION: BP 134/82 mmHg, weight 74 kg, BMI 25.6 (obese). Cardiovascular and respiratory exams normal. Neurological exam: normal vibratory sense at ankles, mild distal weakness resolved.
IMPRESSION: Vitamin B12 deficiency correcting; neuropathy resolved. Consider stopping supplement after confirming normal levels.
ARRANGEMENTS: Order serum B12, MCV, Hb, fasting lipid profile and FBS. Give influenza vaccine today (15‑Oct‑2025). Advise maintain weight <23 BMI via Mediterranean diet and 150 min/week aerobic activity. Return if new numbness, weakness, confusion, chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C or blood in stools.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum vitamin B12: 460 pg/mL (ref 200‑900). MCV: 92 fL (ref 80‑100). Haemoglobin: 13.5 g/dL (ref 13.0‑17.0). Fasting lipid profile: total cholesterol 188 mg/dL, HDL 42 mg/dL, LDL 108 mg/dL, triglycerides 140 mg/dL. Fasting blood sugar: 95 mg/dL.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Methylcobalamin 1500 mcg oral once daily. Continue for 2 more months, then review.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment booked for 2026-04-15 at 10:30 AM with Dr Priya Natarajan (D03) for routine follow‑up. Patient confirmed via clinic app.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: pre‑scheduled follow‑up.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient asymptomatic; no fatigue, tingling or gait issues.
EXAMINATION: BP 132/80 mmHg, weight 71 kg, BMI 24.6 (overweight). Cardiovascular and respiratory exams normal. Neurological exam normal.
IMPRESSION: Vitamin B12 levels now normal; neuropathy resolved. Consider stopping methylcobalamin.
ARRANGEMENTS: Order serum B12, MCV, Hb, fasting lipid profile and FBS. Advise maintain BMI <23 through balanced diet and regular exercise. Influenza vaccine status: received 15‑Oct‑2025; next due autumn 2026. Return if new numbness, weakness, confusion, chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C or blood in stools.

memories.text: Serum vitamin B12: 480 pg/mL (ref 200‑900). MCV: 90 fL (ref 80‑100). Haemoglobin: 13.8 g/dL (ref 13.0‑17.0). Fasting lipid profile: total cholesterol 182 mg/dL, HDL 44 mg/dL, LDL 102 mg/dL, triglycerides 130 mg/dL. Fasting blood sugar: 92 mg/dL.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Methylcobalamin stopped. No further supplementation required unless symptoms recur.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: annual review.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports feeling well; no neurological symptoms.
EXAMINATION: BP 130/78 mmHg, weight 69 kg, BMI 23.8 (overweight). Cardiovascular and respiratory exams normal. Neurological exam normal.
IMPRESSION: Vitamin B12 deficiency resolved; lipids and glucose within target. No active problems.
ARRANGEMENTS: Order fasting lipid profile and fasting blood sugar (annual). Give influenza vaccine today (30‑Sep‑2026). Advise maintain BMI <23 via diet and activity. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, neurological symptoms, or blood in stools.
